The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Biscayne Bay...
Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL out 20 NM...
Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM
excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas...

...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in
Arizona...

Gila River At Gila River at Duncan affecting Greenlee County.

Gila River Near Gila River at Calva affecting Graham County.

For the Upper Gila...including Gila River at Duncan, Gila River at
Calva, Gila River near Solomon...elevated river levels are forecast.

feet this  afternoon and remain above bankfull into this evening
due to excessive rainfall that occurred in previous days.

* WHERE...Gila River at Gila River at Duncan.

* WHEN...Until late Friday night.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, water could begin to damage the dike
structure that protects Duncan.

may cause erosion downstream of the bridge.

- Bankfull stage is 18.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river will fall to 12.4 feet early this afternoon.

and remain below flood stage during the early morning hours
Friday.
- Action stage is 16.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
